pr_body:
Motivation:
The HTTP method is a token type defined in [RFC 9110](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9110#name-tokens).
> token          = 1*tchar
> tchar           =
>  "!" / "#" / "$" / "%" / "&" / "'" / "*"
>   / "+" / "-" / "." / "^" / "_" / "`" / "|" / "~"
>   / DIGIT / ALPHA
>   ; any VCHAR, except delimiters

We need to validate the HTTP method to ensure it conforms to the standard.

Modifications:
- Validate the first word of the HTTP request initial line.
- Throw `IllegalArgumentException` if the method is invalid.

Result:
- Fixes [#14201](https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14201#issue-2427986466).
